# Town Council

![Mountain Village Town Hall](https://townofmountainvillage.com/site/assets/files/1828/town_hall.500x250.jpg)

## Your Elected Officials

All Town Council members are elected to serve four-year terms with an election held in June in odd-numbered years. The Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem are selected through a vote of Town Council. The Mayor and Town Council may be emailed as a group at [council@mtnvillage.org](mailto:council@mtnvillage.org).

This democratically-elected governing body is responsible for adopting policies and procedures with the intent to foster a community where people want to live, work and visit. Regularly, Council follows [Rules for the Conduct of Meetings and General Business](https://townofmountainvillage.com/site/assets/files/1828/rules_for_the_conduct_of_meetings_and_general_business.pdf).

To include members of the public who cannot attend meetings in person, you may watch all Town Council meetings live or on-demand later. When the meeting is in session, the public may live stream through the link below, or tune in and participate virtually via zoom. Zoom links for each meeting are shared in meeting agendas.

**Please note: the March 13, 2025 Special Town Council Meeting can be viewed [here](https://us06web.zoom.us/rec/share/M6KJOC3oGOD3K-CnNmcI3K1ZRyLJPcgTufsVMmeQTPE1rsMWwyeGlCQTWeU-JxWk.ZLq1BUyh3muh_eMJ).**

[Watch Meetings On-Demand](https://media.avcaptureall.cloud/?customerGuid=f6f590a7-5acc-4d32-9928-ad9ae0d02e06&target=foo&view=thumbs&tabs=past%7Ctoday%7Cupcoming)

## Public Comment

The public is invited to provide comments both in writing to council members or at our monthly meetings. Please review our public comment policies below. 

### Public Comment During Meetings

- Town Council will take your comments during all virtual Town Council meetings through the Zoom app using the raise hand function.  When called upon, the presiding officer will acknowledge those who have indicated that they would like to speak and unmute the speaker.
- Please do not comment or use the raise hand function until the presiding officer opens the agenda item to public comment.
- All those wishing to give public comment must identify their full name and affiliation, if any, to the Town of Mountain Village.
- Please keep your comments as brief and succinct as possible and under two minutes. Please refrain from repeating what has already been said by others in the interest of time. You may simply state that you agree with a previous speaker’s comments.
- No presentation of materials through Zoom screen sharing shall be allowed for nonagendized speakers unless submitted 48 hours prior to the meeting date.
- Commenters shall refrain from personal attacks and maintain a civil tone while giving public comment.
- Written materials submitted after the packet deadline of noon on the Thursday prior to the meeting date will be accepted and distributed to Council members and included in the packet after the meeting.

 

### Written Public Comment

Written communication from the public to Town Council can be delivered in a number of ways: it can dropped off at Town Hall, faxed, mailed, emailed and even handed to us on the street. Sometimes written communication addresses issues that are agendized for an upcoming Town Council meeting. In an effort to standardize the inclusion of all agenda-related written public comments in Town Council packets the following procedure has been instituted:

1. Agenda-related written communications received in the mail, fax, hand-delivered or via [email](mailto:mvclerk@mtnvillage.org) will be directed to the Town Clerk’s Office and copies added to the Town Council packet.
2. The deadline for communications to be included in the Town Council packet is noon the Thursday preceding the Town Council meeting.
3. When written communication is received after the Town Council packet deadline, it will be forwarded to the Town Clerk's Office to email to Town Council and other affected parties.
4. All communications related to planning issues are to be distributed in a similar manner as set forth above by the planner while also copying the Town Clerk’s Office.

When public comment is received on a matter that is determined to be quasi-judicial in nature, that comment will be entered into the record by the town clerk as part of the complete record to be considered by Town Council.

## Meeting Material

Digital copies of our meeting agenda, minutes and packets are posted to our website for public consumption the Friday before the Town Council meeting. All agenda items presented are thoroughly investigated by the staff so that Council is armed with the most comprehensive information before making decisions affecting you.

Regular meetings are noticed by posting the entire agenda in public places: Mountain Village and Meadows post offices, Mountain Village Police Department bulletin board, two bulletin boards in Mountain Village, Village Court Apartments and here on this webpage. In the instance where Town Council calls an emergency or special meeting, we will post the announcement in these public places stated above 24 hours prior to the meeting. Agendas are subject to change without notice.

For meeting material prior to 2022, please visit our [Archive Center](https://townofmountainvillage.com/archive-center).
